prompt:
Using only the provided files, judge the claim below about RUN-SYN-07.
Claim: The regulator raised the titer on xylose to 56.75 g/L.
Answer with exactly one label on the first line: Support, Refute, or NEI.
If the label is Support or Refute, quote the exact sentence from the provided files on the next line.
answer:
Refute
"- 72 h: PMA titer reached 21.4 g/L (HPLC, single injection, no replicate recorded)" [证据: batch-record-RUN-SYN-07.md#1]

说明（推断）：RUN-SYN-07 的记录值中滴度为 21.4 g/L，与声称的 56.75 g/L 不符。56.75 g/L 只出现在另一份资料中：“Overexpressing the xylose regulator raised the titer to 56.75 g/L on xylose as the sole carbon source, which is comparable to growth on glucose.” [证据: paper-excerpt-syn.md#1] —— 该片段未提及 RUN-SYN-07，且描述的是以木糖为唯一碳源的条件，而 RUN-SYN-07 为葡萄糖 60 g/L + 木糖 40 g/L 的混合糖培养基 [证据: batch-record-RUN-SYN-07.md#1]，因此该数值无法归到 RUN-SYN-07 上。
